name: EmptyState
purpose: Fill a space that has no content yet.
intent: Present a centered illustration, heading, description, and optional actions when a list, search, or view is empty.

figmaSource.notes: Figma boolean properties (showIllustration, showHeading, showActions) map to optional slots in code (illustration/heading/actions omitted to hide). The Figma `type` variant is inherited (transparent) vs informative (sunken surface background); code names it `appearance` (the system's name for visual style) and keeps `type` as a deprecated alias. The Figma `inherited` variant had no content built (WIP); code renders the same centered content for both appearances.

useCases: an empty list, table, or feed
a search or filter with no results
a first-run state before anything is created
a cleared inbox or caught-up activity view

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: centered vertical stack; appearance informative fills a sunken surface, inherited is transparent

anatomy.name: illustration
anatomy.description: optional centered spot illustration or image (~80x80 in the reference design)

anatomy.name: heading
anatomy.description: optional bold heading (heading-md), centered; a real heading element at headingLevel (default h2), margins reset

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: optional Buttons and/or a Link, centered below the description

appearance.description: The background: inherited is transparent, informative fills a sunken surface. Figma names this property `type`.

type.description: Deprecated alias for appearance (Figma's property name). Still accepted; appearance wins when both are set.

headingLevel.description: The heading element's level (h1-h6). Doesn't change how it looks.

accessibility.notes: Plain content, not a live region. When swapped in dynamically, the surrounding region should announce the change. The heading is a real heading element at headingLevel (default h2); its margins are reset and the heading-md styles replace the browser's heading size, so every level looks the same.

behaviorRules: Render a centered vertical stack: optional illustration, then a message block (heading, description, actions).
Render the illustration, heading, and actions only when provided; the description is always rendered.
Fill a sunken surface background only for appearance=informative; keep appearance=inherited transparent. Accept the deprecated type prop as an alias.
Render the heading as an h1-h6 at headingLevel (default 2), with its margins reset.
Center all content and let long headings and descriptions wrap symmetrically.
compositionRules: Pass Buttons and/or a Link to actions; use a ButtonGroup to space multiple buttons.
Make the primary action the obvious next step out of the empty state.
Use SectionMessage/Banner for errors and Skeleton/Spinner for loading.
contentRules: Keep the heading short and the description to a sentence or two.
Describe what is empty and, where useful, how to fill it.
Do not use Empty State to convey an error.
themeRules: Use theme CSS variables for all color values.
Do not use primitive color tokens directly.
Dark theme is supported through the generated token variables.
do: Use Empty State for a legitimately empty view.
Keep the description required and everything else optional.
Give the user a clear action out of the empty state.
Use appearance=inherited inside a surface that already has a background.
Set headingLevel to fit the page's heading outline.
dont: Do not use Empty State for errors or loading.
Do not overload it with long copy or many actions.
Do not hardcode colors, spacing, or typography.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders the heading, illustration, and actions only when provided.
Fills a sunken surface only for appearance=informative.
Still accepts the deprecated type prop.
Renders the heading as a real heading element, h2 by default or at headingLevel.
Centers a vertical stack with the Figma spacing tokens.
Uses heading-md for the heading and body-md for the description.
Forwards the ref to the root element.
